what: The config files OpenCode 1.18.34's TUI merges, read for their `permission` key only, and the deny patterns an Always scope names when its grant would cover them. Hand-written: the daemon reads these files as the TUI does (later files win, no {env:} or {file:} substitution) and says when one cannot be read instead of naming an incomplete list.
